ModMetaData.name: Local C# Fixes
ModMetaData.author: micro
ModMetaData.description:
Local Harmony patch mod that suppresses NREs / log spam and fixes small runtime bugs from workshop mods where an XML patch can't reach.
Reconstructed 2026-07-05 from the recovered project spec after the original (Windows) copy was lost. MUST load LAST, after every other mod (enforce placement in RimSort). Compiled on Linux against RimWorldLinux_Data/Managed via dotnet-sdk.
